fb_text:
No install. No account. No sales call.

Here's the whole pitch, and it takes 60 seconds to check if I'm lying: go to the demo page, and text it like your crew texts you.

Tap one: log a visit note the way your guy would send it from the truck. Watch it turn into a real service log.

Tap two: ask it the gate code for a client. It answers. That's the moment every owner-operator gets it — no more 7 AM phone calls for a code you typed in once.

Tap three: watch it draft the recap your client would get. Proof of the visit, in writing, before anyone argues about whether you showed up.

Three taps and you just ran a whole visit from a text message. No app for your crew to download, no training, no credit card.

If it doesn't click in 60 seconds, close the tab. You've lost nothing but a minute:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
